c1.descriptionRaw: Alyosha regenerates 15 Elemental Energy when nearby party members trigger an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro-related reaction</color> on an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
c1.name: Frostvale Thunderclap

c2.descriptionRaw:
The duration of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Advance</color> is extended by 6s.
Additionally, each time {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks the opponent, he will also apply the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} to a target. This effect does not activate existing <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Marks</color>.
c2.name: Howl From Afar

c3.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderbolt Strike</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
c3.name: Friendly Call

c4.descriptionRaw: When {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks, he will also restore 60% of Alyosha's ATK as HP to the nearby party member with the lowest HP by percentage.
c4.name: Harvest the Spoils

c5.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Advance</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
c5.name: When the Nightbird Falls Silent

c6.descriptionRaw: The <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> effect obtained from activating a {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} can now stack, max 2 stacks. When the stack count reaches 2, characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> will also have their Elemental Mastery increased by 100 if they are on the field.
c6.name: Standard Reclaimed

profile.description: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.
profile.name: Alyosha
profile.title: Swift-Striding Hound

combat1.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes and applies the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} to the opponent hit by the final strike.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents in his path.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
combat1.name: Skirmishing Spear

combat2.descriptionRaw: Follows his hunter's instincts. Tap or hold to produce different effects as well as apply the {LINK#N11480001}Hunter's Mark{/LINK} effect to the hit opponents. Tapping Fires at opponents in front of him, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Holding Enters aiming mode, then targets opponents within a certain area in front of him. Alyosha's Interruption RES is enhanced when in this mode. At the end of the button hold, he deals Electro DMG to the targeted opponents. The reckless hunter once reached for the spear's edge, and it was only after they survived a lesson paid in blood that they came to understand the harsh truths of survival on the frozen plains.
combat2.name: Thunderbolt Strike

combat3.descriptionRaw: Summons his trusted companion Tugarin to fight alongside him on the field. This also turns an area in front of him into a Fulgurite Hunting Field for a short time. Fulgurite Hunting Field · Continuously taunts nearby opponents to incite them to attack. · Every 2s, deals an instance of AoE Electro DMG to any opponent that enters the field. Tugarin · If there are any opponents nearby, Tugarin will quickly move close to an opponent and maul them every 2s, dealing Electro DMG. · If an opponent affected by the Hunter's Mark effect is hit, the Hunter's Mark will also be activated. · Where there are multiple opponents, Tugarin will attack those affected by the Hunter's Mark effect first. Wait. Keep waiting until the impatience fades. That's when the red-bellied plover shall sweep across the birch grove and present itself before one's arrow.
combat3.name: Hunter's Advance

passive1.descriptionRaw: When {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks, it will also restore HP to nearby active characters at 120% of Alyosha's ATK.
passive1.name: Awakened by the Baying Hounds

passive2.descriptionRaw: Increases the DMG Alyosha deals with his Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst by 0.35% for every 1% of his Energy Recharge. Up to a 70% increase can be obtained in this way.
passive2.name: Suffer the Winter Wheat Will

passive3.descriptionRaw:
Alyosha will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: The <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> effect obtained when the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} is activated will also increase Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by the character when on the field by 20%.
passive3.name: Into the Fray

passive4.descriptionRaw: Displays the location of nearby <color=#FFD780FF>resources unique to Snezhnaya</color> on the mini-map.
passive4.name: Treetop Watch
